# Dungeon Fighter Online

Dungeon Fighter Online (DFO) is an arcade-style, side-scrolling action game with RPG elements, offering players a dynamic combat experience.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dungeon-fighter-online/.

## Actions

- **Character Base Information**: Retrieve base information of a specific character.
- **Character Search**: Search for characters by name on a given server.
- **Character Status Info**: Retrieve status information of a specific character.
- **Character Timeline**: Retrieve the timeline of a specific character.
- **Get Character Skill Buff Avatar**: Fetch skill buff avatar equipment for a character.
- **Get Character Skill Buff Equipment**: Retrieve skill buff equipment details for a character.
- **Get Character Skill Buff Status**: Fetch character's skill buff status information.
- **Get Server List**: Retrieve the list of available game servers.
